policy: Every reviewed non-grid layout/data-management surface must be canonical-backed or carry an explicit parity blocker; eligible-legacy is forbidden.

surfaces.name: Card
surfaces.reason: React Card exposes HTMLAttributes<HTMLDivElement> and a div root. Replacing that public native host with a Custom Element changes DOM/tag and event-currentTarget semantics; the generic canonical display element does not yet adopt an existing native root.

surfaces.name: Stack
surfaces.reason: React Stack exposes HTMLAttributes<HTMLDivElement> over its div root. Canonical vf-stack preserves children but cannot adopt that native host without changing the captured React DOM and event target contract.

surfaces.name: Inline
surfaces.reason: React Inline exposes HTMLAttributes<HTMLDivElement> and native div event semantics. Direct Custom Element replacement would change the public DOM host despite visual-property parity.

surfaces.name: Panel
surfaces.reason: React Panel owns section/header/heading/body structure with ReactNode title, description, actions, and children. Generic vf-panel only provides a region host and cannot preserve that composed DOM contract.

surfaces.name: Section
surfaces.reason: React Section owns semantic section/header/action composition with ReactNode content while the generic canonical display host does not reproduce or adopt that structure.

surfaces.name: AppShell
surfaces.reason: React AppShell owns header/sidebar/main/footer ReactNode regions and native div root semantics; vf-app-shell consumes and rewrites Light-DOM slot nodes into its own scaffold, so direct conversion changes ownership and host behavior.

surfaces.name: Page
surfaces.reason: React Page owns a semantic main root, composes PageHeader and toolbar/body regions, and accepts rich title/status/action content. Direct vf-page adoption cannot preserve the current native host and composed React subtree contract.

surfaces.name: PageHeader
surfaces.reason: React PageHeader accepts ReactNode title, description, eyebrow, status, metadata, actions, and breadcrumbs; canonical vf-page-header models title/description/eyebrow as strings and rewrites named Light-DOM regions.

surfaces.name: PageToolbar
surfaces.reason: React PageToolbar owns left/right ReactNode regions on a native div root. Canonical vf-page-toolbar rewrites Light-DOM slot ownership and adds toolbar host semantics, which requires an adoption contract before parity-safe migration.

exitCriteria.native-host-contract: Add a shared canonical Light-DOM/native-host adoption capability that preserves documented native root tag, HTML attribute typing, event currentTarget/ref semantics, classes, and children.
exitCriteria.rich-composition: Add framework-neutral rich named-region composition/adoption that preserves ReactNode content, semantic native roots, existing wrapper DOM, and consumer event/ref contracts without canonical DOM replacement.
